issue_context.title: Remove insecure serving configuration from cloud controller manager libraries
issue_context.body:
The [insecure serving configuration](https://github.com/kubernetes/cloud-provider/blob/v0.24.0-alpha.4/app/config/config.go#L37-L38) in the cloud controller manager libraries is deprecated, and similar configuration has been removed from most other components (apiserver https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/91506, kube controller manager https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/106860).  We should remove the insecure serving flags and configuration from the cloud controller manager libraries to complete the deprecation and be consistent with the kube controller manager.

/sig cloud-provider
comments:
We discussed this in sig-cloud-provider today and determined we would like to ask for an exception for code freeze.  The change is small and removes insecure serving configuration from cloud-controller-managers which has been deprecated for 4 years.

/triage accepted
/milestone v1.24

review_comments: AddUnqualifiedFlags marked these flags as deprecated and hid them right?

Not hidden, but marked as deprecated: 
```
Insecure serving flags:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     
      --address ip                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
                The IP address on which to serve the insecure --port (set to '0.0.0.0' or '::' for listening in all interfaces and IP families). (default 0.0.0.0) (DEPRECATED: see --bind-address instead.)                                                                                                                                                                         
      --port int                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     
                The port on which to serve unsecured, unauthenticated access. Set to 0 to disable. (DEPRECATED: see --secure-port instead.)           
```
https://kubernetes.io/docs/reference/using-api/deprecation-policy/#deprecating-a-flag-or-cli. Checked the timeline and field has been deprecated for the last 4 years.
